verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You were a lover before time's beginning
You gave Your love freely withholding nothing
Jesus my Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You carried the weight of the world on Your shoulders
You stopped at nothing to prove You were for us
Jesus my Jesus

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
It's extravagant
It doesn't make sense
We'll never compre - hend
The way You love us

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
It's unthinkable
Only Heaven knows
Just how far You'd go
To say You love us

verse.name: o1
verse.lines: To say You love us, to say You love us

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You don't belittle our pain and our suffering
You comfort us in our greatest unraveling
Jesus my Jesus

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You are the dawn that is breaking within me
You are the sun that is rising around me
Jesus my Jesus

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Here is all my love
It's Yours, no con - ditions
When You pull me close
No I won't re - sist it
